name: Biscuit Tin Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from durable, high-quality tinplate metal.
    - Sturdy construction with smooth edges and a secure-fitting lid to help protect contents from dust and moisture.
    - Lightweight, reusable, and designed for long-term use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    Available in multiple sizes:
    - Small (S): 7.09" × 4.33" × 1.57" ~ 18 × 11 × 4 cm
    - Medium (M): 8.50" × 4.96" × 2.80" ~ 121.6 × 12.6 × 7.1 cm
    - Large (L): 8.66" × 6.50" × 3.15" ~ 122 × 16.5 × 8 cm
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Single-sided UV printing on the lid.
    - Vibrant colors with sharp details and excellent image clarity.
    - Scratch-resistant and fade-resistant printing for long-lasting personalization.
    - Suitable for custom names, photos, artwork, logos, and special designs.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
    - Do not soak in water or place in a dishwasher.
    - Avoid abrasive cleaners, scrubbing pads, and harsh chemicals.
    - Store in a cool, dry place away from excessive moisture.
    - Handle with care to maintain the quality of the printed surface.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Ideal for storing biscuits, cookies, candies, chocolates, and other treats.
    - Can also be used to organize tea bags, stationery, craft supplies, sewing accessories, keepsakes, and small household items.
    - Functions as both a decorative storage box and a practical organizer for home, office, classroom, or kitchen use.
    - Reusable and easy to clean, making it a versatile storage solution for everyday needs.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - This personalized Biscuit Tin Box makes a thoughtful and practical gift for people of all ages.
    - It is suitable for birthdays, Christmas, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Teacher Appreciation Day, graduations, housewarming celebrations, anniversaries, and many other special occasions. 
    - With custom printing options, it becomes a memorable keepsake that combines functionality with personal meaning.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape Pillow

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
